meta.title: IDEO-Scrum
meta.description: Design thinking and Scrum Sprints for solo work with AI. In a Standard session, type /scrum-master, /developer, /stakeholder or /supporter, optionally followed by your task. The roles and methods share the Claude Code edition's source. Commitments from the current project's logs enter model context, without a separate request. Start DSH with IDEO_SCRUM_COMMITMENTS=off to disable reminders. Some included third-party material is non-commercial only.
